game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_CHANNEL | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_INVISIBLE

context.description_en: Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level.  Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level%, and %third_ability_level%.Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options.  The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen. Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
context.description_zh: 将当前掌握的元素精华融合，创造出新的法术供祈求者施放。每个元素球的等级都会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_orb%秒元素祈唤的冷却时间。祈求者达到%first_ability_level%、%second_ability_level%和%third_ability_level%时会分别额外获得一点技能点。祈求者高深的魔法学识让他可以从多个阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果中进行选择。物品必须先激活才能生效，而且选择后无法更改。点击帮助按钮可查看所有可用法术。
notes_en: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
notes_zh: 生成的技能与三个球的排列顺序无关。
只是交换现有技能的位置并不会消耗魔法，也不会触发元素祈唤的冷却。
元素祈唤不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

context.description_zh:
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。

每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
notes_en: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.
notes_zh: 淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。

context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。

subject: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
definition: 立刻重置冷却
evidence: Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。

context.description_en: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
context.description_zh: 暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。

scepter_loc.en: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
scepter_loc.zh: 移动速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%%，攻击速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。

subject: grimstroke_ink_creature
definition: 立刻重置冷却
evidence: If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.
若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

context.description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
context.description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
notes_en: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

subject: kez_switch_weapons
definition: 立刻重置冷却
evidence: Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.
施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。

context.description_en: Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
context.description_zh: 凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。

scepter_loc.en: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.
scepter_loc.zh: 在使用流派变换后%scepter_cooldown_timer%秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。

context.description_en: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果%disable_range%范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
notes_en: Marksmanship procs have true strike.
notes_zh: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。

subject: vengefulspirit_command_aura
definition: 提供额外金钱或经验
evidence: XP earned by her illusion is given to her.
幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。

context.description_en: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
context.description_zh: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。
notes_en: Break disables the damage aura.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。

scepter_loc.en: Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

definition: 提供额外金钱或经验
evidence: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

context.description_en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
context.description_zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
notes_en: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.
notes_zh: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。

Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes.
Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.
牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。
巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

context.description_zh: 牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
notes_en: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.
notes_zh: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。
